_source: Manually curated from https://untappd.com/blog's 'New Badge: X' posts - these are Untappd's own time-limited promotional badges, never in the permanent badges.untappd.com catalog (badge_beer_categories.json/badge_venue_categories.json), so they have to be read and re-catalogued by hand whenever a new one is announced. Checked live 2026-09-26 - only entries confirmed ACTIVE as of that date are listed (activeFrom <= today <= activeUntil); anything already past its activeUntil at cataloguing time was skipped rather than included pre-expired. Re-check the blog periodically (no feed/API for this - it's a real page read each time) and prune entries whose activeUntil has passed, same way this list was built.

special_badges.note: Global, no venue restriction - check in any one (1) beer styled Märzen or Festbier in the window.

Same two styles as the global Celebrate Oktoberfest badge above, but ONLY counts at a Flying Saucer location - venueChain is informational only for now, nothing in this codebase currently verifies venue-chain membership automatically.

Untappd's own blog post spelled one style 'Geueze' (typo) - normalized to the real current style name 'Lambic - Gueuze' here. The post's bare 'Gose'/'Fruited Gose' were expanded to the current taxonomy's three separate Gose substyles (Traditional/Fruited/Other) since a bare 'Gose' isn't a real style string on its own - see badge_stats.py's own _STYLE_ALIASES for why a stray non-canonical string is worth avoiding.
Check in any one (1) beverage from a Canadian brewery in the window - matches had_it_index's own 'country' field, same as the permanent country_badges catalog.
